prompt:
Character reference sheet, one wide image in two parts, photorealistic photograph. LEFT two-thirds: full-body turnaround of the same person, three views side by side at identical scale: front view, exact 90-degree side view, exact 180-degree back view, relaxed A-pose. RIGHT third: close-up head-and-shoulders portrait of the SAME person facing camera, mouth closed. Plain light-grey background, soft even studio light at a neutral white balance, no shadows, natural skin texture with pores, no text, no labels, no watermark.
The person: 路少泽, a fictional 28-year-old, Ji Ran's ex-boyfriend of four years, driven off by Ji Hongyuan five years ago and now heir of the Lu Group returning as her arranged-marriage match; the face, skin and build of exactly that age, which the role does not change. Appearance: Handsome East Asian man in his late twenties. Angular face with a sharp jaw, narrow sharp eyes, a straight nose and thin lips that settle into a superior set. Healthy skin with natural texture. Black hair styled in a slicked-back, side-parted pompadour. About 182 cm tall with a fit, trim, average build. He wears a silver dress watch.. Wearing one outfit only: Flashback, five years earlier, aged about 23: a plain light-blue cotton button-down long-sleeve shirt, grey slim chinos and brown loafers. Softer, un-styled hair.. Signature colour: blue. Expression in the close-up shows: Once a meek, humiliated young man, he is now smug, arrogant and possessive. He flaunts his wealth and assumes Ji Ran still loves him. He is easily provoked into speechless fury.. The full-body views keep the body's build and proportions as the appearance gives them, head-to-body ratio included, never slimmer. Cast as a commercial live-action short drama: an adult lead (the heroine, the hero) or a young adult woman in a prominent role is a strikingly beautiful or handsome, camera-ready actor, with the figure, make-up, hair and fitted outfit the appearance and outfit give; a character under 18 looks and dresses like an ordinary child or teenager of that age and is never styled to look sexy; any other supporting role is an ordinary-looking person of that age.
The outfit is identical in every view and in the close-up: the same garments, accessories and details on the same side of the body, seen from that view's angle (an earring on the left ear stays on the left ear; a tie, a pocket square, gloves or hair ribbons are in every view or in none). Garments are plain, with no logo, brand mark, or printed letters or numbers.

Avoid: a different face between the views, an older-looking or younger-looking face than 28, doll-like face, a second outfit, extra people, extra limbs, text or labels.
